title: Go: String Manipulation
description: Manipulate strings — measure length, concatenate, use the strings package, convert with strconv, and format with fmt.Sprintf.

steps.title: String Length and Indexing
steps.description: Declare `s := "Hello"`, print its length with `len(s)` and the first character with indexing `s[0]`.

verification.failureMessage: Print length (5) and first byte (72) of 'Hello'.

steps.title: String Concatenation
steps.description: Create `firstName := "John"` and `lastName := "Doe"`. Concatenate them with a space and print the full name.

verification.failureMessage: Concatenate 'John' and 'Doe' with a space and print 'John Doe'.

steps.title: strings Package
steps.description: Use the `strings` package to check if `"Golang is fun"` contains `"fun"` (`strings.Contains`), convert to uppercase (`ToUpper`), and split on space.

verification.failureMessage: Use Contains, ToUpper from strings package and print results.

steps.title: strconv Conversion
steps.description: Use `strconv.Atoi` to convert `"123"` to int and `strconv.Itoa` to convert `456` to string. Print both results.

verification.failureMessage: Convert '123' to int and 456 to string, print both.

steps.title: fmt.Sprintf Formatting
steps.description: Use `fmt.Sprintf` to format `name := "Go"` and `year := 2009` into `"Go was created in 2009"` and print it.
hints: `result := fmt.Sprintf("%s was created in %d", name, year)`

verification.failureMessage: Format 'Go was created in 2009' using fmt.Sprintf and print it.
